'''Ellorrs Madak's blaster pistol''' was a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] personally owned by [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]], known to use the alias Ellors Madak. This model [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was carried by many [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] pilots, who found it useful when negotiations got heated.<ref name="TCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Ellorrs Madak's Blaster Pistol|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/17Cellorrsmadaksblaster.html}}</ref>
